description: scriptconv's espeak-ng backend (Phonemizer.ESPEAK) via the espeak-ng subprocess/library, IPA-native. get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='həlˈoʊ', get_ipa('mundo','pt-PT')=='mˈũŋdʊ' - genuine rule-based phonemization, distinct output per word verified on 3 samples/lang.
notes: Verified working for en-US and pt-PT in the shared venv, no extra package required beyond the system espeak-ng binary (already present). PROVENANCE: espeak-family output is a rule-based TTS-adjacent tool, not human-reviewed - it competes as a fighter fine, but per this repo's provenance-tier convention (tool_derived must be false for a dataset to count as gold) espeak-derived transcriptions must never be used as a gold/reference source for future g2p datasets.
